aggregation.utility: mean over the dataset's valid views
aggregation.predicted_utility: mean over the dataset's valid views
aggregation.selection: fraction of the dataset's views in which the metric is in the Top-5 by predicted utility

selection_semantics.rule: argsort of stored predicted utility; no model executed

downstream.why_online: both arms deployable, complete per-dataset outputs, and it is the regime the deployed system actually runs; the offline fixed-32 table is NOT mixed in

permutation.family_scheme: shuffle family labels across datasets, sizes preserved
permutation.subfamily_scheme: shuffle subfamily labels WITHIN each parent family only

population_note: specialisation is measured on Splits 2-16 (OOF utility population); the Full60-vs-Head14 downstream gain is measured on Split 1. The two signals are therefore independent by construction, and their association is a family/subfamily-level statement, never per-dataset.

evidence_levels.1_causal_bundle: Full60 vs Head14; AutoClust/ML2DAC A-arm contrasts
